 Angel One Limited
Commenting on Angel One’s performance, Mr. Dinesh Thakkar, Chairman & Managing Director
said, “India is witnessing one of the largest wealth creation opportunities in its history, and
technology is making financial services more accessible than ever before. We believe the next
decade will belong to platforms that combine innovation, trust and execution at scale.

Angel One is evolving into an AI-powered financial platform designed to serve clients across
trading and investing, wealth, credit and global markets. Every product we build, every capability
we add and every investment we make is guided by a simple objective: helping clients make better
financial decisions and achieve their aspirations.
Our ambition is to build a platform that becomes an indispensable part of every client's financial
journey. With strong foundations, multiple growth engines and a relentless focus on client
outcomes, we are confident in our ability to create enduring value while contributing meaningfully
to India's financial future.

Commenting on Angel One’s performance, Mr. Ambarish Kenghe, Group CEO said, “The second
quarter reinforced the resilience of our client franchise despite significant changes in India’s
market structure including revised bank funding norms and introduction of the Closing Auction
Session in cash equities. While these changes temporarily impacted broking activity, client
engagement recovered steadily, with our average daily orders reaching 5.8 million in September
2026, approaching pre-CAS levels. More importantly participation deepened as our average client
funding book reached a record high of ₹ 74.5 billion, growing by 40.5% year-on-year.
Customer preference remained strong across our platform. We increased our share of retail equity
derivatives turnover to 22.1%, up 43 basis points year-on-year, while commodity turnover more
than doubled.
We continue to evolve our platform into a broader financial-services ecosystem. During the
quarter, we began the early beta of Loan Against Securities within our NBFC and will scale the
product with discipline and responsibility. Supported by our AI and ML-powered underwriting and
risk models, monthly credit distribution reached a record high in September 2026. We also
received authorization to operate as a Global Access Provider in the IFSC, creating a pathway to
offer customers investment opportunities beyond domestic markets.

Combined with a standalone operating margin of 48.9%, above our guided range, these
investments position us well to deepen customer relationships across investing, borrowing and
wealth creation, while capitalizing on India’s long-term financialization opportunity.”

 Angel One Limited
About Angel One Ltd.
Angel One Limited (NSE: ANGELONE, BSE: 543235) is one of India’s leading FinTech platform,
transforming how millions invest and build wealth. With a user base of over 40 million, the
company offers a wide range of digital-first solutions across broking, credit mutual fund,
advisory, wealth and asset management (AMC) and distribution of third-party financial products.

With a sharp focus on scalable tech, Angel One integrates AI, machine learning and data-driven
intelligence to deepen client engagement and retention. Our flagship Super App and developerfocused SmartAPI - an open API platform for traders, and Smart Money - a comprehensive
investor education platform, are designed to serve users which are mobile-first, data-savvy and
growth-driven. Combining FinTech innovation with deep industry expertise, Angel One is
empowering clients in their financial journey.

Megamont Limited Secures ¥2.13 Crore Pigeon Peas Import Contract
from Africa, Targets India's FMCG Sector
Mumbai, October 15, 2026: Megamont Limited (BSE: 523888), a diversified global commodity trading company,
has secured an import contract valued at approximately ¥2.13 crore for Pigeon Peas (Tur/Arhar), to be sourced
from Mozambique or Malawi in Africa.
The contract marks another step in the Company's strategy to diversify its commodity portfolio and expand its
presence in India's agricultural supply chain, with the objective of supplying essential agricultural commodities to
domestic FMCG companies, food processors and institutional buyers.

Supporting India's Domestic Agricultural Supply Chain
Pigeon Peas are among India's widely consumed pulses and form an important part of the country's staple food
basket. International sourcing plays a complementary role in supporting domestic availability and meeting the
requirements of India's food-processing and consumption markets.
Through this transaction, Megamont aims to leverage its global sourcing capabilities to establish reliable
procurement channels for essential agricultural commodities, while strengthening its participation in India's
domestic food supply chain.
The Company intends to market the imported Pigeon Peas to FMCG manufacturers, food-processing companies
and other institutional customers, supporting its strategy of developing long-term relationships across
consumption-driven industries.

Favourable Policy Environment Aligns with Megamont's Long-Term Vi

on

The Government of India has extended the free import policy for Tur/Pigeon Peas until March 31, 2027,
supporting continued international sourcing of the commodity to supplement domestic supplies.
This policy environment aligns with Megamont's broader vision of establishing a Global Multi-Product Trading
House, connecting key commodity-producing regions with major consumption markets across geographies.
By expanding its international sourcing network and diversifying into essential commodities, Megamont aims to
build a scalable trading platform serving multiple industries and markets.
The Company's strategy also focuses on identifying commercial arbitrage opportunities arising from differences
in international commaodity prices, sourcing costs and domestic market demand, while maintaining disciplined
trade execution and risk management.

Strengthening Global Sourcing and Market Reach
®

The contract provides for sourcing Pigeon Peas from Mozambique or Malawi, expanding Megamont's
participation in African agricultural trade corridors.

®

Shipments are scheduled between November and December 2026, with delivery at Nhava Sheva Port, India.

®

The transaction complements Megamont's existing presence across metals, energy, industrial commodities
and agricultural products, further advancing its strategy of building a diversified global trading business.

Management Comment
Mr. Tejas Patil, (Director, Megamont Limited)

"At Megamont, our long-term vision is to build a globally

connected, multi-product trading house that bridges international sourcing opportunities with demand across
key consumption markets. Our entry into Pigeon Peas imports from Africa aligns with this vision and provides an
opportunity to strengthen our presence in India's FMCG and food-processing supply chains. By connecting global
commodity-producing regions with India's growing domestic demand, we aim to establish reliable sourcing
channels and develop long-term relationships with FMCG companies, food processors and institutional buyers.
Going forward, we intend to expand our product portfolio and geographical reach across key commodities and
markets. We believe that leveraging international sourcing networks, understanding regional market dynamics
and identifying commercial arbitrage opportunities can help us build a diversified and scalable trading business.
Our focus remains on efficient trade execution, disciplined working capital management and sustainable growth,
with the objective of creating long-term value for the Company and its shareholders."

About Megamont Limited
Megamont Limited is an international trading and supply-chain company engaged in sourcing and supplying
industrial raw materials, metals, energy commodities, edible oils and agricultural commodities across global
markets. The company operates across diverse product portfolios including edible oils and agri commodities,
metals and mining resources, building materials, industrial chemicals and rubber, machinery and equipment,
electronics and technology, energy and petrochemical products. With sourcing relationships across India, CIS,
China, Brazil, South Africa, Russia and Europe, Megamont combines sourcing, trade structuring, trade finance,
logistics and risk management to connect global producers with industrial and commercial buyers.
